results.q: Son 30 günde toptan satış ne kadar?
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE 0 END) AS satis
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (8)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-08-07' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2026-09-07'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE -INVOICE."NETTOTAL" END) AS net_ciro
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'

SELECT date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_") AS ay, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE -INVOICE."NETTOTAL" END) AS net_ciro
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")

results.q: Perakende ile toptan satışları 2026 ay bazında karşılaştır
results.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_") AS ay, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS toptan_satis
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3) THEN STLINE."AMOUNT" ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8) THEN STLINE."AMOUNT" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS iade_oran
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-07-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-08-01'

SELECT CLCARD."SPECODE2" AS kanal, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE -INVOICE."NETTOTAL" END) AS net_ciro
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
JOIN "dbo"."LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
GROUP BY CLCARD."SPECODE2"
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC

SELECT CLCARD."SPECODE2" AS kanal, SUM(INVOICE."NETTOTAL") AS iade_tutari
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
JOIN "dbo"."LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY CLCARD."SPECODE2"
ORDER BY iade_tutari DESC

SELECT ITEMS."SPECODE" AS yayinev, SUM(STLINE."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
JOIN "dbo"."LG_411_ITEMS" AS ITEMS ON STLINE."STOCKREF" = ITEMS."LOGICALREF"
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ITEMS."SPECODE"
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE 0 END) AS satis_tutar
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-08-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2026-09-01'

SELECT 1 - SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8) AND STLINE."OUTCOST" <> 0 THEN STLINE."AMOUNT" * STLINE."OUTCOST" ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8) AND STLINE."OUTCOST" <> 0 THEN STLINE."TOTAL" ELSE 0 END), 0) AS brut_kar_marj
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-09-01'

SELECT SUM(INVOICE."NETTOTAL") AS toplam_tutar
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (1)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'

SELECT date_trunc('month', ORFICHE."DATE_") AS ay, COUNT(DISTINCT ORFICHE."LOGICALREF") AS siparis_sayi
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_ORFICHE" AS ORFICHE
WHERE ORFICHE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND ORFICHE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', ORFICHE."DATE_")
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', ORFICHE."DATE_")

results.q: 2026 yılında KITAPCI, E-TICARET ve DAGITICI kanalları için ay bazında net ciro
results.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_") AS ay, CLCARD."SPECODE2" AS kanal, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE -INVOICE."NETTOTAL" END) AS net_ciro
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
JOIN "dbo"."LG_411_CLCARD" AS CLCARD ON INVOICE."CLIENTREF" = CLCARD."LOGICALREF"
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND CLCARD."SPECODE2" IN ('DAGITICI', 'E-TICARET', 'KITAPCI')
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_"), CLCARD."SPECODE2"
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")

FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_STLINE" AS STLINE
WHERE STLINE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND STLINE."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE."TRCODE" IN (8)
  AND STLINE."DATE_" >= '2026-07-01' AND STLINE."DATE_" < '2026-08-01'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE."NETTOTAL" ELSE -INVOICE."NETTOTAL" END) AS net_ciro
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2026-09-07'

results.q: Perakende (TRCODE 7) ile toptan (TRCODE 8) satışları 2026 ay bazında karşılaştır: her ay için fatura sayısı, NETTOTAL toplamı ve ortalama fatura tutarı; ayrıca perakendenin o ayın toplam satışındaki payı.
results.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_") AS ay, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS toptan_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_7_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_8_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS toptan_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS perakende_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_7_satis, SUM(CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (8) THEN CASE WHEN INVOICE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8, 9) THEN INVOICE.[NETTOTAL] ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END) AS trcode_8_satis
FROM "dbo"."LG_411_01_INVOICE" AS INVOICE
WHERE INVOICE."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (2, 3, 7, 8, 9)
  AND INVOICE."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND INVOICE."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01' AND INVOICE."DATE_" < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")
ORDER BY date_trunc('month', INVOICE."DATE_")
